name: Supergent Bridge
description: Bridge interface to Supergent Agent OS kernel, workforce coordinator, RAG sources, and Apprise notification channels.

executeTool.description: Execute any tool in the Supergent 290-tool registry with specific arguments.

tool_name.description: Name of the Supergent tool to execute (e.g. read_file, execute_command, git_clone_repo, etc.).

arguments.description: Dictionary of arguments required by the specified tool.

searchRAG.description: Query Supergent 15 scientific and academic RAG knowledge sources (arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, Wikipedia, etc.).

sources.description: Comma-separated list of sources to search (e.g. 'arxiv,wikipedia,pubmed'). Defaults to all sources.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return per source.

runWorkforce.description: Submit a multi-step task to Supergent Multi-Agent Workforce (RootPlanner decomposing task into DAG of SubTasks executed by async Workers).

task_description.description: Detailed description of the complex task to decompose and execute.

sendNotification.description: Send an alert or notification via Supergent Apprise engine across 199 supported schemes (Telegram, Discord, Slack, Email, etc.).

channel.description: Logical channel name or direct Apprise URL scheme.

getHealth.description: Query Supergent runtime health, awareness metrics, tool count, and active subsystems.

searchSkills.description: Search across Supergent library of 1,727 Agent Skills for specialized workflows and technical procedures.

query.description: Skill topic, technology, or procedure to search.

top_k.description: Maximum number of skill matches to return.
